title: Ensemblis Media Worker Contract v1
invariants: Every dispatched payload carries the contract version marker.
Unknown contract versions fail before job execution.
Job type names are stable discriminators across TypeScript and Python.
Every job type maps to a stable platform processor id without changing the job-specific payload contract.
Terminal callbacks are idempotent and may be delivered more than once.
Payload/result objects remain job-specific and are validated at their owning domain boundary.
